definitions: Having a shade of color that is rather dark.
A mental or emotional state, composure.
Emotional character (of a work of music, literature, or other art).
Used to express that the speaker finds something very relatable.

blocks.text: Dusky is an English electronic music duo from London consisting of Alfie Granger-Howell and Nick Harriman. Formed in 2011, they have released music on various records labels, before setting up their own label 17 Steps in July 2014 with the release of the Love Taking Over EP.
